prerequisites.browser_recheck: A separately installed compatible browser and automation package; browser binaries are intentionally not included. The demo itself is static HTML.
prerequisites.java: Observed OpenJDK 17.0.20; needed only to replay the GTFS validator JAR.
prerequisites.node: Observed v24.22.1; required for Workbench, admission, economic model and bundled converter.
prerequisites.oasdiff: Bundled 1.34.1 executable is Linux x86-64; other platforms require their own matching upstream build.
prerequisites.paper_rebuild: A compatible LaTeX installation plus the Python plotting dependencies used by the paper builders; the completed PDF and figures are included.
prerequisites.python: Observed 3.12.14. Standard library suffices for normalized-JSON comparator/oracle and packaging.
prerequisites.pyyaml: Observed 6.0.3; required to import the acquisition/production driver and for YAML input normalization.
